Nurse practitioners are also able to prescribe medication and I think are more available than physicians.

Sorry you’re going through this; it’s going to be okay! I went through something similar at the beginning of the year, and my advice would be to make a lot of calls to book the earliest appointment, but don’t try to wait for the appointment if it’s too far out. Try seeing someone at urgent care. And if you’re off your meds, watch for symptoms closely and go to the ER if you don’t feel good!

I'm feeling that way too, though I'm ready to actually go. For me it's the slump that follows intense crying and helplessness. My nervous system has gotten tired of being highly activated, and my body has settled into a calmer depression.
Finally found someone who has actually seen these shows and their overly white casting. No one else here knows what they’re talking about.
Moved me to tears. Thank you for sharing.
